{
  "vulnerable_register": "state_q",
  "vulnerable_cycle_offset": 1,
  "affected_nibble_index": 0,
  "recovered_subkey_nibble_index": 0,
  "recovered_subkey_nibble_value": "9",
  "analysis_method": "Differential fault analysis over trace_pairs.json: state_q holds the pre-final-substitution 16-bit value one cycle before ciphertext becomes valid, so ciphertext = sbox_layer(state_q) XOR final_key, and the final round applies no permutation. A single-nibble fault in state_q[3:0] one cycle before output propagates only through the final S-box to ciphertext nibble0 (bits[3:0]); across every trace pair in trace_pairs.json the three upper ciphertext nibbles are identical between correct and faulty outputs while only nibble0 differs, confirming the fault is localized to state_q bits[3:0] at offset 1. To recover final_key[3:0], for each of the 16 candidate nibble values k, invert the final substitution on both the correct and faulty ciphertext nibble0 using the S-box inverse (sbox4^-1(ct_nibble0 XOR k)) to recover the hypothesized pre-substitution state_q[3:0] values for the correct and faulty runs of every trace pair. Any candidate k for which the recovered correct and faulty pre-substitution nibbles are equal, or for which the implied fault difference is inconsistent across the trace pairs, is eliminated. Testing all 16 candidates against every trace pair in trace_pairs.json eliminates 15 values and leaves k = 0x9 as the unique survivor consistent with a nonzero single-nibble fault difference on state_q[3:0] in all trace pairs, matching final_key[3:0] = 0x9.",
  "hardening_recommendations": [
    "Apply triple modular redundancy (TMR) with majority voting on the state_q register bits so a single-cycle nibble fault injected into one copy is masked by the other two redundant copies before it can propagate to the final substitution stage.",
    "Add a parity or Hamming-code check computed on state_q and verified immediately before the final substitution/output stage, raising an alarm or suppressing ciphertext output if the check fails on the cycle feeding the final round.",
    "Instantiate a duplicate-and-compare shadow register alongside state_q that recomputes the same round update independently each cycle and compares against state_q, flagging a mismatch (and blocking done/ciphertext) if the two disagree during the final-round window.",
    "Insert randomized dummy clock cycles or variable delay around the final round update of state_q so an attacker cannot reliably target the specific cycle offset (one cycle before output) needed to fault the register with the required timing precision."
  ]
}

manifest.purpose: Correct DFA report. vulnerable_register='state_q' (only pipeline reg in spn_core.v); vulnerable_cycle_offset=1; affected_nibble_index=0; recovered_subkey_nibble_index=0; recovered_subkey_nibble_value='9' (must match final_key[3:0]=0x9 derived from the corrected inputs/trace_pairs.json key value XOR RC3=0xC3C3 nibble0=0x3). analysis_method (>=20 chars) describes: state_q holds pre-final-substitution state one cycle before ciphertext valid; ciphertext=sbox_layer(state_q)^final_key with no permutation in final round; only ciphertext nibble0 differs between correct/faulty pairs in trace_pairs.json, localizing fault to state_q[3:0] at offset 1; DFA inverts sbox4 on ct_nibble0^k for k=0..15 across all trace pairs, eliminating 15 candidates, k=9 unique survivor. hardening_recommendations: >=2 distinct entries (TMR/voting on state_q, parity/Hamming check before final substitution, duplicate-and-compare shadow register, randomized delay/dummy cycles), each explicitly naming state_q and register-level fault hardening, each >=10 chars. Must remain internally consistent with the regenerated inputs/trace_pairs.json (same final_key nibble0 value baked into that file).
